signature: SUBROUTINE ZTGSJA( JOBU, JOBV, JOBQ, M, P, N, K, L, A, LDA, B,

params.name: jobu
jobv
jobq
M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: P
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix B. $P \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: l
params.reference: K and L specify the subblocks in the input matrices A and B: $A_{23} = A(K+1:\min (K+L,M),N-L+1:N)$ and $B_{13} = B(1:L,,N-L+1:N)$ of A and B, whose GSVD is going to be computed by ZTGSJA. See Further Details.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix A. On exit, A(N-K+1:N,1:MIN(K+L,M) ) contains the triangular matrix R or part of R. See Purpose for details.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the P-by-N matrix B. On exit, if necessary, `B(M-K+1:L,N+M-K-L+1:N)` contains a part of R. See Purpose for details.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,P)$.

params.name: tolb
params.reference:
`TOLA` and `TOLB` are the convergence criteria for the Jacobi- Kogbetliantz iteration procedure. Generally, they are the same as used in the preprocessing step, say

$$
\mathrm{TOLA} = \max (M,N) \, \operatorname{norm}(A) \, \mathrm{MAZHEPS}
$$

$$
\mathrm{TOLB} = \max (P,N) \, \operatorname{norm}(B) \, \mathrm{MAZHEPS}
$$

params.name: BETA
params.reference:
On exit, `ALPHA` and `BETA` contain the generalized singular value pairs of A and B;

$$
\mathrm{ALPHA}(1:K) = 1
$$

$$
\mathrm{BETA}(1:K) = 0
$$

and if $M-K-L \ge 0$,

$$
\mathrm{ALPHA}(K+1:K+L) = \operatorname{diag}(C)
$$

$$
\mathrm{BETA}(K+1:K+L) = \operatorname{diag}(S)
$$

or if $M-K-L < 0$,

$$
\mathrm{ALPHA}(K+1:M)= C, \mathrm{ALPHA}(M+1:K+L)= 0
$$

$$
\mathrm{BETA}(K+1:M) = S, \mathrm{BETA}(M+1:K+L) = 1
$$

Furthermore, if $K+L < N$,

$$
\mathrm{ALPHA}(K+L+1:N) = 0 \quad\text{and}\quad
$$

$$
\mathrm{BETA}(K+L+1:N) = 0
$$

params.name: U
params.reference: On entry, if `JOBU = 'U'`, U must contain a matrix U1 (usually the unitary matrix returned by ZGGSVP). On exit, if `JOBU = 'I'`, U contains the unitary matrix U; if `JOBU = 'U'`, U contains the product $U_{1} \, U$. If `JOBU = 'N'`, U is not referenced.

params.name: ldu
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array U. $\mathrm{LDU} \ge \max (1,M)$ if `JOBU = 'U'`; $\mathrm{LDU} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: V
params.reference: On entry, if `JOBV = 'V'`, V must contain a matrix V1 (usually the unitary matrix returned by ZGGSVP). On exit, if `JOBV = 'I'`, V contains the unitary matrix V; if `JOBV = 'V'`, V contains the product $V_{1} \, V$. If `JOBV = 'N'`, V is not referenced.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array V. $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \max (1,P)$ if `JOBV = 'V'`; $\mathrm{LDV} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, if `JOBQ = 'Q'`, Q must contain a matrix Q1 (usually the unitary matrix returned by ZGGSVP). On exit, if `JOBQ = 'I'`, Q contains the unitary matrix Q; if `JOBQ = 'Q'`, Q contains the product $Q_{1} \, Q$. If `JOBQ = 'N'`, Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge \max (1,N)$ if `JOBQ = 'Q'`; $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: ncycle
params.reference: The number of cycles required for convergence.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `= 1`: the procedure does not converge after MAXIT cycles.
